mean_cn: v.生根；翻找；  n.根，根茎，根部
mean_en: the part of a plant that grows under the ground and absorbs water and minerals that it sends to the rest of the plant; the origin or basis of something; the part of a word that has the main meaning and that its other forms are based on; a word that other words are formed from
sentence: The tree deeply roots in the soil.
sentence_trans: 这棵树深深地扎根于土壤之中。
